name: Derived Category Exact Triangle Constraint
description: Exact triangles induce long exact sequences in cohomology; verified via z3 SAT/UNSAT and sympy axiom derivation

pyg.reason: triangle is abstract, no graph structure

z3.reason: SAT/UNSAT consistency of exact triangle and long exact sequence

cvc5.reason: z3 sufficient for morphism composition constraints

sympy.reason: symbolic derivation of octahedron axiom and composition rules

clifford.reason: no clifford algebra structure in derived categories

geomstats.reason: derived category is algebraic, not geometric

negative_nonzero_composition.contradiction: exact triangles require all compositions to vanish

negative_broken_sequence.claim: Triangle exact but long exact sequence broken
negative_broken_sequence.contradiction: exact triangle must give long exact sequence in cohomology

negative_missing_maps.claim: Exact triangle with missing maps f and g
negative_missing_maps.contradiction: exact triangle requires all three maps

boundary_octahedron_axiom.statement: Cone(f) → Cone(g∘f) → Cone(g) → Cone(f)[1] is exact
boundary_octahedron_axiom.significance: determines how cones interact under composition

boundary_rotation_invariance.property: distinguished triangles are closed under rotation

boundary_composition_symbolic.theorem: In exact triangle A→B→C→A[1], composition g∘f vanishes
boundary_composition_symbolic.interpretation: maps compose to zero in derived category

boundary_cone_uniqueness.property: mapping cone is unique distinguished triangle for any morphism
boundary_cone_uniqueness.universal_property: Hom(Cone(f), X) characterizes extensions by f

boundary_ses_to_triangle.connection: SES in abelian category lifts to distinguished triangle
